ETag middleware and validator helpers. Uses FNV-1a 64-bit hash for deterministic ETags. Shared hash/match primitives live in etag_core.nim (single source of truth). Relies on response layer to compute and set the ETag header after body is ready.Returns ETagOptions defaults: weak mode, hmGet and hmHead only, existing ETag headers respected.Builds an ETag for content from its length and stableHash64 digest, weak or strong per mode.Builds a weak-mode ETag for content by delegating to the two-argument overload.Builds the etag middleware that stores mode, allowed methods, and header policy in response locals.
